captions.title: The Companion Story
captions.text:
What most people get wrong about trading is they think it's about having the hottest stock tip. It's not. It's about having clarity when everyone else has noise.

That's why I became a companion for Ask Ape.

Ask Ape AI - http://AskApe.com - is not a broker, it's not an auto-trader, and it will never promise you returns. What it is, is an AI financial copilot built specifically for retail investors who are tired of guessing.

Think of it like ChatGPT, but trained to speak the language of the market in plain English. You can ask it "why did this stock move today?" "break down this earnings report" "what does this chart pattern actually mean?" and it gives you fast, accurate, educational answers without the Wall Street jargon.

My role? I help people use it correctly. I show traders, beginners, and busy professionals in New York and beyond how to turn hours of research into minutes. How to discover ideas, understand the WHY behind market news, and build confidence in their own decision-making. We don't execute trades for you - we give you the tools to think smarter so you can make your own decisions with better data.

This is for the person who wants to learn, not just follow. If you want to understand the market instead of being intimidated by it, this is where you start.

The market will always be volatile. Your research process doesn't have to be.

Learn more at http://AskApe.com. For educational purposes only. Not financial advice.
